Native Canvas Interaction: live editor state <-> semantic checkpoints
|-- [M] Integration boundary
|   |-- MappingEditorCanvas consumes a mounted CanvasSession
|   |   |-- Mounts tldraw with mapping shapes, selection tools and application overlays
|   |   `-- Provides CanvasRuntime to renderer components through context
|   |-- MappingEditorRuntime bridges Editor <-> session.controller
|   |   |-- Controller supplies snapshots, semantic commands and checkpoint history
|   |   |-- Exposes settle(), undo(redo) and dispose(); attaches an editor driver
|   |   `-- Keeps projection cache, checkpoint tracking and synchronization guards internal
|   |-- CanvasRuntime exposes renderer models, anchors, routing, focus and gesture services
|   |   |-- Application command UI installs CanvasActions callbacks
|   |   `-- Internal model atoms preserve equal branches via shareEqual
|   `-- Routing boundary
|       |-- NativeRoutingStore depends on Editor transforms and ConnectionRouter
|       `-- ConnectionRouter is a pure routing cache shared by worker and headless callers
|
|-- [O] State and resource responsibility
|   |-- tldraw Editor owns live shape geometry, camera and native history navigation
|   |-- Controller supplies semantic state and an immutable checkpoint archive
|   |-- MappingEditorRuntime owns subscriptions and the last projected shape baseline
|   |-- CanvasRuntime is created per session
|   |   |-- Retains grids, floating panes, side panels, edges and revision-scoped focus
|   |   |-- Owns LocalAnchorStore and NativeRoutingStore
|   |   `-- Shares gesture selection ownership with MappingEditorRuntime
|   `-- Unmount / editor replacement releases resources
|       |-- CanvasRuntime.connect() returns its controller unsubscribe callback
|       |-- MappingEditorRuntime.dispose(): complete -> settle -> unsubscribe in reverse order
|       |-- Canvas removes camera/font/pointer listeners and selection-tool registration
|       `-- Clearing CanvasRuntime.editor disposes routing
|           `-- Terminate worker; clear queued jobs, completed output and settled arrows
|
|-- [C] Semantic state -> native shapes
|   |-- Startup: hydrate from controller.editorHistory()
|   |   |-- Replay checkpoint IDs into native history, then undo through future entries
|   |   `-- Materialize current shapes; historical geometry is reconstructed on navigation
|   |-- Controller subscription detects relevant document, view, display or selection changes
|   |   |-- Application selection changes claim selection ownership
|   |   `-- publish() projects the current snapshot
|   |       |-- Same checkpoint + pointer held -> defer projection until a later idle tick
|   |       |-- New command checkpoint -> mark native history stopping point
|   |       `-- Write shape differences and document.meta.mappingCheckpoint together
|   |-- [D] projectMappingShapes(snapshot) -> native mapping shapes
|   |   |-- Presentation scene + diagram views + cell dimensions
|   |   |   `-- Grid boxes -> parent-relative positions, sizes, revision IDs and root lock
|   |   |-- Display nodes + selection + visibility rules
|   |   |   `-- Floating panes; collapsed/docked conversations use 36 x 36 anchor bubbles
|   |   |-- Document edges -> locked arrow shapes
|   |   `-- Alternative side-panel layout -> locked panel shapes
|   `-- writeShapes()
|       |-- Delete obsolete mapping shapes; create missing shapes; update changed shapes
|       |-- Bring arrows and side panels to front
|       |-- Native selection = semantic diagram selection + retained drag-only selection
|       `-- Cache projected values for later gesture comparison
|
|-- [C] Native gesture -> settled semantic change
|   |-- Editor store observes shape or native selection changes -> mark dirty
|   |-- Tick while pointing, dragging or pinching -> leave live geometry with Editor
|   `-- Idle tick -> settle dirty geometry -> publish any deferred projection
|       |-- Compare native shapes with the projection baseline
|       |   |-- Moved grid shapes -> page coordinates / cell size
|       |   |   `-- Round and clamp to nonnegative row/column -> move operations
|       |   |-- Supported diagram clones -> duplicate-instance operations with new IDs
|       |   |   `-- Unsupported clone sets are removed instead of committed
|       |   `-- Moved/resized floating panes -> updated display geometry
|       |       |-- Manual placement; changed dimensions select fixed sizing
|       |       `-- Collapsed conversations also update canvasAnchor
|       |-- Selection boundary
|       |   |-- Native selection retains drag-only diagram IDs when capture is allowed
|       |   |-- Content membership changes through explicit application gestures
|       |   `-- Pending application selection suppresses native selection capture
|       `-- Geometry changed -> controller.commitEditorGesture(moves, canvas)
|           `-- Synchronization guards prevent projection writes from becoming new gestures
|
|-- [C] Undo / redo crosses the checkpoint boundary
|   |-- Runtime undo(redo): complete editor gesture -> settle -> inspect controller history
|   |   |-- Workspace-transfer transaction -> require workspace undo/redo
|   |   `-- Otherwise -> editor.undo() or editor.redo()
|   |-- Native document checkpoint changes -> synchronous after-change handler
|   |   `-- controller.restoreEditorCheckpoint(id) -> publish(false)
|   |       `-- Rebuild shapes from restored semantic state without recording new history
|   `-- Application Delete/Backspace -> controller delete-diagrams command
|       `-- Semantic cleanup remains an application responsibility
|
|-- [D] Renderer output depends on semantic models plus live geometry
|   |-- CanvasRuntime.sync() reads document, display, diagram views, selection and cell size
|   |   |-- Publishes grid, floating-pane, side-panel and edge models in one transaction
|   |   |-- Reuses equal model branches so unrelated diagrams keep stable values
|   |   `-- Retains routing owners and anchor measurements against current layouts
|   |-- Anchor identity and measurement
|   |   |-- Scene + views + DiagramAnchor -> resolved endpoint
|   |   |   `-- Subtract owning grid origin -> shape-local endpoint rect + layoutKey
|   |   |-- Layout key includes revision, ASCII hash, view, cell, collapse and alternative
|   |   `-- LocalAnchorStore
|   |       |-- Stores per-endpoint atoms; rounds measurements to 0.01
|   |       |-- get() accepts only measurements matching the requested layoutKey
|   |       |-- Font loading invalidates measurements; changed layouts clear stale values
|   |       `-- Missing owners remove records; camera motion and DOM culling do not
|   |-- Connection focus
|   |   |-- focusNode() accepts only a content node in the current diagram revision
|   |   |-- Incoming/outgoing matches require display ID + content ID + revision ID
|   |   `-- Deleted edges, changed revisions or selection changes clear affected focus
|   `-- routedEdges
|       `-- Edge IDs + edge models -> nativeEdgeInput(...) -> routing.drawAll(...)
|           |-- [D] World obstacles
|           |   |-- Current-layout measurements, or diagram-derived local obstacles
|           |   `-- Editor shape page transforms -> world obstacle rectangles
|           |       `-- Camera is not a routing dependency
|           |-- [C] Dragging -> previewEdge using prior settled route when available
|           `-- [C] Settled geometry
|               |-- Worker unavailable -> synchronous ConnectionRouter.drawAll
|               |-- Matching completed job -> reuse arrows
|               `-- New inputs/obstacles -> queue routing job; return previews meanwhile
|                   |-- At most one in-flight job; retain only newest pending request
|                   |-- Publish completion only if its key is still the requested key
|                   |-- Worker error -> terminate, disable worker, invalidate asynchronously
|                   |   `-- Subsequent evaluation uses synchronous routing
|                   `-- ConnectionRouter.drawAll
|                       |-- Filter obstacles for each connection's endpoint identities
|                       |-- Reuse route when input key and nearby obstacles match
|                       |-- Otherwise drawResolvedEdge -> cache route and affected region
|                       `-- spaceEdgeArrows -> lane cache; preserve equal arrow objects

    |-- Camera initialization: center content, restore saved transform, or use default
    |-- Camera reactor updates overlay CSS transform without application React state
    |-- Camera tick: changed transform -> captureViewCamera + optional callback
    |   `-- View-camera capture is separate from commitEditorGesture
    |-- Restored checkpoint viewport -> restore Editor camera
